headlines.title: 2026年2500亿元超长期特别国债支持消费品以旧换新资金已全部下达
headlines.summary: 近日，国家发展改革委会同财政部，向地方下达了今年第四批625亿元超长期特别国债支持消费品以旧换新资金。至此，全年2500亿元消费品以旧换新资金已全部下达。下一步，各有关部门将继续指导地方合理把握工作节奏，优化资金使用计划，规范高效做好补贴审核兑付，严厉打击骗补套补等违法违规行为，有效发挥消费品以旧换新政策效能。

headlines.title_en: All 250 billion yuan in ultra-long special treasury bonds for 2026 supporting trade-ins of consumer goods has been allocated
headlines.summary_en: Recently, the National Development and Reform Commission, together with the Ministry of Finance, allocated to local governments the fourth batch of this year's 62.5 billion yuan in ultra-long-term special treasury bonds to support consumer goods trade-ins. With this, the full 250 billion yuan for consumer goods trade-ins for the year has been fully allocated. Next, relevant departments will continue to guide local governments to reasonably pace their work, optimize fund usage plans, conduct subsidy reviews and payments in a standardized and efficient manner, crack down on illegal activities such as fraudulent and duplicate subsidy claims, and effectively leverage the effectiveness of the consumer goods trade-in policy.

headlines.title_en: A-share midday review: Shanghai Composite rose 0.27% in the morning session, CRO concept led gains
headlines.summary_en: Jinshi Data, September 30 - The three major A-share indices opened higher in the morning but then fluctuated downward. As of midday close, the Shanghai Composite Index rose 0.27%, the Shenzhen Component Index fell 0.06%, and the ChiNext Index fell 0.17%; half-day turnover in the Shanghai and Shenzhen markets was 909.3 billion yuan, up 33.1 billion yuan from the previous trading day. More than 2,600 stocks in the overall market rose. On the board, the real estate sector staged a V-shaped rebound, with Lujiazui, Shenwuye A, and Zhongtian Service hitting the daily limit, while Binjiang Group, Xinda Real Estate, Shenshenfang A, China Vanke A, and China Merchants Shekou followed higher. The CRO concept led gains, with CanSino Biologics up 20CM at the daily limit, and Joinn Laboratories, Nanhua Bio, Vland Biotech, and Menovo Pharmaceutical hitting the daily limit. The grain concept rebounded, with Yalian Development hitting the daily limit, and Denghai Seeds and Wanxiang Doneed rising more than 5%. The memory chip sector, PCB concept, MLCC concept, and CPO sector were among the biggest decliners, with Aohong Electronics and Huaci Shares hitting the daily limit. Cultivated diamond board

headlines.title: 中国银行：积极落实《关于实施居民购房贷款贴息政策的通知》
headlines.summary: 中国银行公告，为深入贯彻落实党中央、国务院有关决策部署，支持城乡居民刚性住房需求，切实减轻符合条件购房家庭的利息负担，中国银行积极落实《关于实施居民购房贷款贴息政策的通知》（财金〔2026〕95号）精神及相关要求，自2026年10月1日起，针对符合政策条件的商业性个人住房贷款开展财政贴息工作，确保政策红利惠及广大消费者。同时，将优化办理流程，简化办理手续。

headlines.title_en: Bank of China: actively implementing the Notice on Implementing the Interest Subsidy Policy for Residential Mortgage Loans
headlines.summary_en: Bank of China announced that, in order to thoroughly implement the decisions and arrangements of the CPC Central Committee and the State Council, support the rigid housing demand of urban and rural residents, and effectively reduce the interest burden on eligible homebuying families, Bank of China is actively implementing the spirit and relevant requirements of the Notice on Implementing the Interest Subsidy Policy for Resident Home Purchase Loans (Caijin [2026] No. 95). Starting October 1, 2026, it will carry out fiscal interest subsidy work for eligible commercial personal housing loans to ensure that the policy benefits reach consumers broadly. At the same time, it will optimize processing procedures and simplify handling formalities.

headlines.summary_en: In September, the PMI for large manufacturing enterprises was 50.6%, unchanged from the previous month, with large enterprises remaining in expansion; the PMIs for medium and small enterprises were 49.7% and 48.9%, respectively, up 0.3 and 1.0 percentage points from the previous month, with business conditions rebounding in both.

headlines.title_en: A-share midday review: Shanghai Composite rose 0.27% in the morning, more than 2,300 stocks advanced, real estate stocks rebounded from lows
headlines.summary_en: The Shanghai Composite Index fluctuated in positive territory in the morning, while the ChiNext Index opened higher and moved lower to close down 0.17%; the Shanghai Composite rose 0.27% and the Shenzhen Component fell 0.06%. Stocks rose and fell mixed, with half-day turnover at 917.3 billion yuan. A total of 2,370 stocks in the two markets rose, with 45 hitting the daily limit. Pharmaceutical stocks strengthened collectively, with CanSino Biologics, Tainuo Maibo, Menovo Pharmaceutical, and Aosaikang and many others hitting the daily limit. Agricultural stocks rallied during the session, with Hainan Rubber hitting the daily limit. Real estate stocks kept rebounding after bottoming, with Shenwuye A staging a floor-to-ceiling move and Lujiazui hitting the daily limit. On the decline, PCB concept stocks dropped, with Aohong Electronics hitting the daily limit.

headlines.summary: 财政部公布2026年第四季度国债发行安排，其中10月计划发行3期超长期特别国债，期限包括20年、30年和50年；10月计划发行1期中央金融机构注资特别国债，期限5年；10月计划发行两期凭证式储蓄国债，期限包括3年和5年。

headlines.title_en: The Ministry of Finance announced the 2026 fourth-quarter government bond issuance plan, including plans to issue 3 tranches of ultra-long special government bonds in October, with maturities of 20 years, 30 years and 50 years
headlines.summary_en: The Ministry of Finance announced the arrangement for the issuance of government bonds in the fourth quarter of 2026, of which three tranches of ultra-long special government bonds are planned for issuance in October, with maturities including 20 years, 30 years and 50 years; one tranche of special government bonds for capital injection into central financial institutions is planned for issuance in October, with a maturity of 5 years; and two tranches of book-entry savings government bonds are planned for issuance in October, with maturities including 3 years and 5 years.
